revision_reason: Loaded words (kinship / religious / affect / social-register) invite memory, doctrine, feeling, and politeness-convention judgment rather than modulation-fit judgment. A 'hit' on them would rediscover Jakobson babbling universals, register, doctrine, or emotion-word convention — not varṇa modulation (the same confound that closed the register-field path: scrambled ~ real 0.967, register dims undefensible). Stable concrete objects have low-association, stable denotation, so the rater's judgment is forced onto MODULATION-FIT, the construct under test.
supersedes: b1_3_human_modulation_candidate_wordlist.json (mixed 72-word pool) as the PRIMARY analyzable set; the prior file is retained, not deleted
rater_wording: Given the dictionary meaning of the object, which option gives a more fitting inner tendency or field around this object without changing what it is?
template_change: loaded-word 4-slot prose template tightened to a constrained 4-field-tag object form: 'Within the fixed meaning, this object is modulated by [tag1], [tag2], [tag3], and [tag4].'
what_did_not_change: hypothesis, instrument (blinded humans), arms, primary endpoint (A_real vs R_deranged; must also beat R_scrambled/R_random/X_neutral), honest low prior, freeze policy, disallowed labels
